title: Love the size, two pouring spouts that drip!
text:
Love the size, two pouring spouts that drip!. This Calphalon classic 2 1/2 qt. is a great size. I have boiled pasta, kept the lid on, poured out the water.
Then add a pasto sauce , parm cheese, and everything stayed warm. A one pot meal.
The pan has two pour spouts , and the lid on each side has the pouring holes.
I used this pot for fresh tomato soup. Simmered nice.
Sounds great ! Not really.
As when I went Too pour the soup in the bowl, this nice pan with the two pour spout Dripped!
Tried it again, and again on both sides, and still this pan Dripped down the sides and was a Mess.
I thought the whole idea of this pan was the pour lip for pouring, and the strainer lid.

I took out a old stainless farberware pan, USA,and it poured like a champ. No dripping at all, and did not have the pour spout .
I have allot of Calphalon commercial , Contemporary, simply, and Unison , There all Calphalon.
This Callphalon classic is there less expensive line,and a much thinner cookware.
Made in China.
The other Calphalon I mentioned are made in the USA, Except the simply, and the Classic.

I think this is a good set if your just starting out, to get the feel of Calphalon cookware.
The handle I really like allot better then there older cookware .
This handle is a bit shorter, fatter, and you can get a good grip on it. I have thin long fingers.
Yes, nothing will stick in this. No BPA , but it does have another type of nonstick inside.

Do NOT put this pan in the dishwasher, do Not use medal utensils, or a high flame.
DO Use wooden spoons, silicone spatulas, and tongs.

description: The Calphalon Classic Nonstick 2. 5-Quart Sauce Pan with Cover features convenient fill lines, a straining cover, and pour spouts to help you save time in the kitchen. The saucepan is made with dual-layer nonstick for extra-easy food release and cleanup, and is constructed from durable hard-anodized aluminum for fast and even heating. Non stick saucepans are ideal for preparing soup, sauces, grains, pasta, and rice, boiling water or reheating foods. With rounded corners for easy stirring, the saucepan is finished with a long, stay-cool stainless steel handle.
